title: Addition and Subtraction of Fractions
description: How to add and subtract fraction numbers with step-by-step examples and calculations

components.content:
# Addition and Subtraction of Fractions

Learn how to add and subtract mixed fractions by converting them to common denominators.

## Addition

**Example 1:** Adding mixed fractions
- 2 3/4 = 2 6/8
- + 4 3/8 = 4 3/8
- + 3 1/2 = 3 4/8
- = 9 13/8 = 10 5/8

**Example 2:** Another addition example
- 10 7/8 = 10 14/16
- + 12 3/16 = 12 3/16
- + 9 1/4 = 9 4/16
- = 31 21/16 = 32 5/16

## Subtraction

**Example 3:** Simple subtraction
- 6 3/4 = 6 6/8
- - 4 3/8 = 4 3/8
- = 2 3/8

**Example 4:** Subtraction with borrowing
- 10 3/16 = 9 19/16
- - 4 3/8 = 4 6/16
- = 5 13/16

outputs.label: Result - Whole Part
outputs.formula: IF(inputs.operation='add', FLOOR((inputs.whole1 + inputs.whole2) + FLOOR((inputs.numerator1/inputs.denominator1 + inputs.numerator2/inputs.denominator2))), FLOOR((inputs.whole1 - inputs.whole2) + FLOOR((inputs.numerator1/inputs.denominator1 - inputs.numerator2/inputs.denominator2))))

outputs.label: Result - Numerator
outputs.formula: IF(inputs.operation='add', ROUND(MOD((inputs.numerator1/inputs.denominator1 + inputs.numerator2/inputs.denominator2), 1) * LCM(inputs.denominator1, inputs.denominator2)), ROUND(MOD((inputs.numerator1/inputs.denominator1 - inputs.numerator2/inputs.denominator2), 1) * LCM(inputs.denominator1, inputs.denominator2)))

outputs.label: Result - Decimal
outputs.formula: IF(inputs.operation='add', inputs.whole1 + inputs.numerator1/inputs.denominator1 + inputs.whole2 + inputs.numerator2/inputs.denominator2, inputs.whole1 + inputs.numerator1/inputs.denominator1 - (inputs.whole2 + inputs.numerator2/inputs.denominator2))
